title: Such a fun experience
text: This was such a fun experience! Our guide was amazing and did such a good job with having us all feel included in the cooking process. He was so easy to talk to and it felt like everyone there were friends by the end of it. If you’re looking for something to do on your trip, I highly recommend this!
author: Inspire45453334588

title: A very wonderful and fun...
text: A very wonderful and fun experience! Our teacher was friendly and patient. Food was delicious! We would do it again.
author: Rhaje_J

title: A Unique Cooking Experience Rooted in Tradition
text: If you want a taste of history, tradition,  elegance, authenticity, charm, and of course a hands-on cooking experience that leads you to the MOST delicious sangria, tapas, and paella … then book with Paella Maestro!! Do you know how tapas originated? What can be made with a piece of bread, a clove of garlic, half a tomato, and olive oil? What are the ingredients of a perfect traditional paella? Book here and you will learn these secrets!! And an added bonus… learn how to drink from a porrón!!! Exceptional is an understatement! Thank you Eladi!
author: kerrykM8551UC

title: Delicious food, prepared in a fun way!
text: Such a great experience. So happy I booked it. Not only ending in a delicious meal, but the explanations of the meal’s existence made so much sense.
author: Tourist799130

title: Amazing Paella Experience in Barcelona
text: This cooking class was an unforgettable highlight of our trip—fun, interactive, and full of authentic Spanish flavors. The chef was passionate and shared fascinating insights about paella, tapas, and sangria, making the whole experience both educational and entertaining. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Barcelona!
author: 62ayag

title: The greatest class
text: The experience was great! I went with my boyfriend and my mom, celebrating her 60th birthday! My mom has been talking nonstop about the class it was very informative and had a great vibe. Class was so good we started making our own sangria at home and we just ordered a paella pan so we can start making this aswell.  20/10 experience would do again!
author: maredlizo

title: History & Good Food
text: Alade (I hope I spelled that right) was so knowledgeable and nice. We laughed, drank sangria and made a fabulous seafood paella!
author: GoingInternational

title: Great paella class!
text: Absolutely fab experience with family while on holiday. I would recommend to anyone interested in making or eating paella in Barcelona.
author: zacharyw753

title: Must do! 10/10
text: SO MUCH FUN! 10/10 you must do this as a couple or family when you come to barcelona. the chef was very informative and willing to share the culture and history behind the dish and kept it very fun and entertaining.
author: brooke e

title: Super nice experience!
text: We had a very nice workshop. The host told a lot about the history of tapas, paella and sangria which was very nice to hear. We were allowed to help with the cutting of the ingredients and were well involved in the process. And most importantly: it was very tasty! The ingredients were very fresh. All in all a great night!!
author: Ilse V
